messages:
zoe (devex): Incoming support case: new user ran `ri quickstart` after signup, CLI printed `402 Payment Required` and then retried for several minutes. They never saw a billing step and CI hung. Need guidance on CLI behavior.

raja (sdk): can you paste the raw log? want to see whether retries come from our HTTP client or a top-level retry wrapper.

zoe (devex): user pasted snippet:
```
2026-12-01T13:05:02Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
2026-12-01T13:05:02Z ri-cli WARN retrying request (1/7) after 1000ms
2026-12-01T13:05:03Z ri-cli INFO POST /v1/firstcall -> 402 Payment Required
... repeats until exit
```
They also ran `ri account status` and saw `billing_state: pending` and `workspace: null`.

michael (infra): 402 is a billing/TOS block, not transient. Retrying hides the real issue and floods logs. We should fast-fail and show a clear action.

raja (sdk): Agreed. Looks like the recent retry refactor treated any non-network 4xx as candidate for retry unless blacklisted. Python already treats 401/402 as terminal; Node/Go diverged. I'll push a patch to blacklist 401/402 across SDKs and update the CLI to print an actionable message and exit non-zero.

zoe (devex): Suggested CLI text: "Account blocked (402): billing required to create a workspace. Run `ri billing add-card` or visit https://console.redwood.ai/settings/billing. Org: <org-id>. If signup used SSO, ask your org admin to complete billing." Also include quick link to `ri account status` output fields so support can triage.

raja (sdk): Opening RD-9001 and PRs: node-sdk#1200, go-sdk#809. Adding an integration test that simulates a 402 and asserts the CLI exits within 2s, prints the help blurb, and emits telemetry `cli.onboard.blocked`. Also adding a parity test to CI to ensure all SDKs keep same behavior.

michael (infra): I'll add a metric for "retries_on_4xx" and an alert if it spikes, so we detect regressions quickly.

deploy-bot: Deployed ri-cli v0.13.4-beta to staging (includes 401/402 non-retry and improved blocked-org messaging). Running quickstart smoke: blocked-org.json :rocket:

zoe (devex): For the current support case I asked user to: 1) run `ri account status` and paste `org_id` and `billing_state`, 2) if billing_state is `pending` or `blocked` follow billing link or contact admin, 3) if signup looked successful but no workspace, escalate with org id and signup email. I'll draft a KB entry and attach a copy-paste reply for support. Marking RD-9001 as onboarding-friction. :memo:
